name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
contribution: A Bangladeshi politician, revolutionary, statesman, activist, and diarist who was the founding president of Bangladesh.
legacy: He became popular for opposing West Pakistan's political, ethnic and institutional discrimination against the Bengalis of East Pakistan; leading the six-point autonomy movement, he challenged the rule of Pakistani president Ayub Khan.

photo_credit: Prime Minister's Office of Bangladesh · Public domain

checks.lead: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman (17 March 1920 – 15 August 1975) was a Bangladeshi politician, revolutionary, statesman, activist, and diarist who was the founding president of Bangladesh. As the leader of Bangladesh, he led the country as its president and prime minister from 1972 until his assassination in a coup d'état in 1975.
